llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed cloud-operations guide that uses shell-based Terraform and Ansible workflows, with explicit review and confirmation steps for risky actions.

dimensions.detail: High-impact cloud operations are expected for this purpose and are described with environment separation, dry-run defaults, review steps, and production confirmation requirements.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only a SKILL.md markdown skill and no bundled executable scripts, installers, hidden setup, or automatic background behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger keywords include broad terms such as cloud, infra, and deploy, but the runtime instructions focus on explicit plan, review, apply, drift, and destroy workflows.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill relies on local or cloud credentials and Terraform state, which are sensitive, but it gives credential-handling guidance and does not add persistence or collect credentials itself.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The requested read and exec capabilities match the stated purpose of running Terraform, Ansible, and cloud CLI workflows for infrastructure orchestration.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you expect an agent to help with real cloud infrastructure. Before running apply, destroy, override-lock, force, or credential-related commands, verify the selected environment, cloud profile, Terraform state backend, and generated plan yourself.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger list is supported by the artifact and could cause early activation, but the skill does not instruct automatic mutation; cloud-changing actions are framed around plan/review/confirmation workflows.
